g.text: Vp = A0 - A3 across R1 (Rp), Vs = A3 - A1 across the sender, Rs = Rp x Vs / Vp.

g.desc: Vp = A0 - A3 across R1 (Rp), Vs = A3 - A1 across the sender, Rs = Rp x Vs / Vp.

g.text: Layout rules: R2 joins R1 pin 1 by its own track (Kelvin); nothing in series between R1 and J2 pin 1;

g.desc: Layout rules: R2 joins R1 pin 1 by its own track (Kelvin); nothing in series between R1 and J2 pin 1;

g.text: R7 (break-detect bias) stays on the harness side of R5. C1-C3 return to GND; the module ties A- to GND itself.

g.desc: R7 (break-detect bias) stays on the harness side of R5. C1-C3 return to GND; the module ties A- to GND itself.

g.text: Harness faults (a wire at 14.4 V): R3/R5 limit clamp current to about 10 mA each into +3V3;

g.desc: Harness faults (a wire at 14.4 V): R3/R5 limit clamp current to about 10 mA each into +3V3;

g.text: D1-D4 hold the taps inside GND..3.3 V; D5 limits transients on the signal wire and does not conduct at 14.4 V.

g.desc: D1-D4 hold the taps inside GND..3.3 V; D5 limits transients on the signal wire and does not conduct at 14.4 V.

g.text: Grounds: a USB supply needn't share the car's ground, so J2 pin 3 is a dedicated return wire to the tank bond stud.

g.desc: Grounds: a USB supply needn't share the car's ground, so J2 pin 3 is a dedicated return wire to the tank bond stud.

g.text: It carries the sender current back to the board. Without it no current flows and the tank floats up to 3.3 V,

g.desc: It carries the sender current back to the board. Without it no current flows and the tank floats up to 3.3 V,

g.text: so the gauge shows GROUND FAULT, never a reading. J2 pin 4 takes the screen or a second return.

g.desc: so the gauge shows GROUND FAULT, never a reading. J2 pin 4 takes the screen or a second return.

g.text: through-hole-usb-v1: one copper layer, through-hole parts only, in its own box. A cable joins J3 to the display's

g.desc: through-hole-usb-v1: one copper layer, through-hole parts only, in its own box. A cable joins J3 to the display's

g.text: 8-way case socket (3.3V, SDA, SCL, each paired with a ground). The display runs from its own USB-C socket.

g.desc: 8-way case socket (3.3V, SDA, SCL, each paired with a ground). The display runs from its own USB-C socket.
